correctness.rationale: Every forest face belongs to at most two parts, with a singleton on one side if both occupied. The relative simplicial chains split canonically by supporting part pair, each pair is a union of two contractible joins meeting in K_{n_i,n_j}, and integral Mayer–Vietoris gives W_i tensor W_j. The global long exact sequence identifies the first homology with the cycle lattice of the complete part graph. Under a part swap, the edge-orientation and cover-order signs cancel. This is an all-parameter integral proof, supplemented by 1,848 exhaustive signed face-character checks and seven independent mod-two boundary computations.
